F1_backend_unavailable_at_launch.scenario: Network unavailable or backend 503 during app cold start
F1_backend_unavailable_at_launch.expected: App opens immediately to Discover/Trips; cached local data displayed; no crash or error wall; auth state remains SignedOut or retains cached user profile gracefully
F1_backend_unavailable_at_launch.actual: PASS: Async session restore handles IOException, catches network errors gracefully without blocking Compose/SwiftUI UI shell

F2_oauth_cancelled.scenario: Traveler opens system browser OAuth and dismisses it / taps cancel
F2_oauth_cancelled.expected: Returns to You tab; remains in SignedOut state; no error loop or intrusive alert dialog
F2_oauth_cancelled.actual: PASS: onNewIntent / ASWebAuthenticationSession cancellation handles cancel event cleanly and resets state to SignedOut

F3_invalid_callback.scenario: Deep link triggered with malformed URL, foreign host, or missing ticket
F3_invalid_callback.expected: Rejected immediately; no credential saved; error state emitted without crashing
F3_invalid_callback.actual: PASS: URI scheme/host/path validation ensures only otravelz://auth/callback with valid ticket parameter proceeds

F4_session_expires_mid_use.scenario: Server invalidates session token while traveler is using the app
F4_session_expires_mid_use.expected: Token cleared from secure store; state transitions to Expired/SignedOut; local browsing/trips continue uninterrupted
F4_session_expires_mid_use.actual: PASS: 401 response invalidates local session store and emits Expired; non-account app functionality operates normally

F5_sign_out_during_active_trip.scenario: Traveler has an active trip milestone in progress and taps Sign Out in You tab
F5_sign_out_during_active_trip.expected: Server session revoked; secure token cleared; active trip progress in Room/SwiftData remains intact and navigable
F5_sign_out_during_active_trip.actual: PASS: Unit tests verify Room trip_progress and saved_trips tables are completely unaffected by logout
